test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 26 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A and B together can complete a work in 12 days. B and C together can complete it in 15 days. C and A together in 20 days. How many days will each take working alone?
solution:
**Given:**

A + B = 12 days

B + C = 15 days

C + A = 20 days

**Formula used:**

Work = LCM of days

Efficiency = Work ÷ Time

**Calculations:**

LCM of 12, 15, 20 = 60

⇒ Total work = 60 units

⇒ (A + B) 1 day work = 60 ÷ 12 = 5 units

⇒ (B + C) 1 day work = 60 ÷ 15 = 4 units

⇒ (C + A) 1 day work = 60 ÷ 20 = 3 units

⇒ Adding all:

⇒ (A + B) + (B + C) + (C + A) = 5 + 4 + 3 = 12 units

⇒ 2(A + B + C) = 12

⇒ A + B + C = 6 units

⇒ A = (A + B + C) − (B + C) = 6 − 4 = 2 units

⇒ B = (A + B + C) − (C + A) = 6 − 3 = 3 units

⇒ C = (A + B + C) − (A + B) = 6 − 5 = 1 unit

⇒ Time taken:

⇒ A = 60 ÷ 2 = 30 days

⇒ B = 60 ÷ 3 = 20 days

⇒ C = 60 ÷ 1 = 60 days

**∴ A = 30 days, B = 20 days, C = 60 days**
